39600.context: Let's take Adam and Eve, for example. The Adam and Eve story in Genesis is often treated as a simple moral parable, but structurally, it functions as a psychological blueprint, one that collapses under scrutiny. There is no evidence for a first human couple, no support from population genetics for humanity descending from two individuals, and no plausible framework in which a talking serpent and a magical tree dispensing moral knowledge makes any sense. These elements are not symbolic add-ons, they are the mechanism of the story.

39600.title: Everything Wrong With Genesis (Because Everything After Depends On It)

39601.context: The flood narrative in Genesis represents the clearest collision between mythic storytelling and moral catastrophe. Scientifically, the story collapses on every front. There is no global geological flood layer, no evidence of a worldwide deluge within the proposed time frame, no feasible way to house feed and preserve millions of species on a single wooden vessel, and no plausible genetic pathway for life to rebound from such an extreme bottleneck without immediate extinction level consequences.
